data.body: The taxonomy registry is the site’s curated vocabulary: categories and tags agents may use. Content referencing an unknown term fails validation instead of minting vocabulary by accident.

Body fields

  • tracking
  • kinds (required)

Patch operations

  • add_term
  • update_term
  • deprecate_term
  • reactivate_term
  • remove_term
  • set_tracking

This reference is generated from the live object_contract. If it disagrees with the contract, the manual is wrong and the drift guard fails the build of it.

Worked example

tax_platform declares Guide and Reference categories plus architecture, publishing, multisite, and testing tags. Its former skincare test term is deprecated and merged into architecture so historical references do not strand.

Lifecycle note

Unknown content terms block validation. Prefer an active term or extend the registry before writing dependent content.
